title: Independent periodic-energy test of HIAM-234b interpenetration
difficulty_reasons: Large periodic MOF models require model construction, fixed-cell optimization and independently chosen electronic-structure validation.
The NIP comparator must be mapped from an interwoven crystal without changing connectivity or net identity.

paper.title: Deconstructing and Rationalizing Interpenetration in Pillar-Layered Metal–Organic Frameworks
paper.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

data.description: CCDC identifier and answer-neutral definitions of the HIAM-234b 2IP and NIP periodic models.
